conditions.requires: Owning JEM modules and the exact optional native mod are installed; native permissions, research, discovery and gameplay remain authoritative.

conditions.delivery: Docs/handbook/delivery.json records build, synchronization and native installation separately from source and acceptance.

modifiers.before: Existing advancements and native tooltips did not provide one shared set of source-reviewed boss tactics and difficult-item instructions.
modifiers.after: 56 canonical boss profiles and 56 difficult items have distinct RU/EN guidance; authored item summaries feed tooltip and native JEI information. Boss Jade reads canonical server participant/waiting state and three exact native Cataclysm protection signals.

rationale.purpose: Make established pack mechanics discoverable through one native handbook and concise owner-backed help.
rationale.decision_source: User requested implementation of the universal book brief, resumed after FTB commit 67d9f215, and required preservation of parallel work.
rationale.user_requested: One dirt-and-stick handbook, seven sections, native manual access and return, bilingual search, enchantment/boss/item help, JEI and Jade integration.
rationale.implementation_choices: Reuse Patchouli and existing assets; read native/domain state, cache resource text on reload, isolate optional integrations and keep explicit evidence gaps.

relations: native/domain state -> presentation adapter -> handbook or tooltip
canonical authored resources -> localized Patchouli pages and JEI information
notes: No client damage-admission model, new boss allowlist, combat modification or native GUI replacement.
Ignis shield is directional; Harbinger arrow immunity is conditional on powered state; Leviathan out-of-water protection reads the native config.
JEMCompat uses the already-installed Lionfish API only as a compile dependency. Combined JAR preserves coordinated seasonal changes, whose independent owners are their two seasonal Atlas records.
Rune of the Storm and Dead Sea Scroll are documented as installed relic/trophy implementations; unsupported Rune weapon-use wording in the separate FTB quest content is flagged without editing it.
unresolved: Full per-boss phase/attack and damage-predicate inventory, live overrides and runtime acceptance are incomplete.
Backpacked unlock_token native spend is confirmed; survival acquisition remains unestablished. Whole-pack no-JEI and translation coverage is not claimed.
